{{Top|leg}}
'''Magma spitters''' were artillery weapons used by [[Yuuzhan Vong]] ground troops to defend stationary objects.

A magma spitter fired what appeared to be burning, molten cannonballs. Four of these launchers were assigned to a single fire-support squad.

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The magma spitter is similar in name to the [[magma missile]] and its [[rock spitter]] launcher, a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] weapons-system that may be a form of [[Yaret-Kor]], but it is not clear if the two devices are related.

Magma ''missiles'' are long-range guided missiles, and ''Star by Star'' indicates they have a solid rock-like fuselage, but in ''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]'', they are described as "gouts", more like magma spitter projectiles.
